outcome: Left ventricular diastolic dysfunction (measured by Left atrial strain reservoir - LASr)
Respiratory support at 24 hours of life
cohort: The study included 27 neonates with transient tachypnea of the newborn (TTN) and 27 healthy control neonates.
finding: Left atrial strain reservoir (LASr) was significantly reduced in neonates with TTN at 2, 24, and 48 hours of life, suggesting left ventricular diastolic dysfunction that may contribute to delayed lung fluid clearance, and LASr at 2 hours was a predictor of respiratory support at 24 hours.
birth_weight: TTN group: 2508 ± 667 g; Control group: 2718 ± 590 g
gest_age: TTN group: 36.1 ± 2 weeks; Control group: 36.9 ± 2 weeks
